L110@P5: 6.1 Environmental Conditions
L111@P5: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at
L112@P5: temperature 23±3℃(@RT) and humidity under 65%.
L113@P5: 6.2 Measuring Equipment
L114@P5: (1) Amp-meter and Volt-meter
L115@P5: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5 mA and
L116@P5: mV or higher.
L117@P5: (2) Slide caliper
L118@P5: The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L119@P5: (3) Impedance meter
L120@P5: The impedance meter with AC 1 kHz should be used.
L121@P5: 7. Characteristics

L123@P5: This "Standard Charge" means charging Cell with charge current of 0.5C and constant
L124@P5: voltage 4.2 V and 0.02C cut-off in CV mode at 23℃ for capacity.
L125@P5: 7.2 Standard Discharge Capacity
L126@P5: The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of Cell, which is
L127@P5: measured with discharge current of 0.2C with 2.50 V cut-off at 23°C within 1 hour after
L128@P5: the Standard charge.

L225@P13: Proper Use and Handling of Lithium Ion Cells
L226@P13: See before using lithium-ion cell
L227@P13: This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions, which
L228@P13: the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium ion cell
L229@P13: to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI in order to obtain optimum performance
L230@P13: and safety.
L231@P13: 1. Charging
L232@P13: 1.1 Charging current
L233@P13: Charging current should be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L234@P13: specification.
L235@P13: 1.2 Charging voltage
L236@P13: Charging should be done by voltage less than that specified in the product
L237@P13: specification.
L238@P13: 1.3 Charging time
L239@P13: Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L240@P13: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a
L241@P13: safety consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L242@P13: specification.
L243@P13: 1.4 Charging temperature
L244@P13: Cell should be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L245@P13: 1.5 Reverse charging
L246@P13: Cell should be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse
L247@P13: charging should be strictly prohibited. If Cell is connected improperly, it may be
L248@P13: damaged.
L249@P13: 2. Discharging
L250@P13: 2.1 Discharging
L251@P13: Cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current specified
L252@P13: in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current should be set, it
L253@P13: shall be discussed together with SDI.
L254@P13: 2.2 Discharging temperature
L255@P13: 2.2.1 Cell should be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the product
L256@P13: specification.
L257@P13: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L258@P13: 2.3 Over-discharging
L259@P13: 2.3.1 The system should be equipped with a device to prevent further discharging
L260@P13-14: exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L261@P14: Spec. No. CC5563F101 Version No. Draft 1.0
L262@P14: Samsung SDI., Battery Business Division.14
L263@P14: 2.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance, characteristics of battery
L264@P14: function.
L265@P14: 2.3.3 Over-discharging may occur by self-discharge if the battery is left for a very long
L266@P14: time without any use.
L267@P14: 2.3.4 The charger should be equipped with a device to detect Cell voltage and to
L268@P14: determine recharging procedures.
L269@P14: 3. Storage
L270@P14: 3.1 Storage conditions
L271@P14: 3.1.1 Cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified as below*4
L272@P14: *4 Store the battery at 0 ~ 23℃, low humidity (below 65%), no dust and no
L273@P14: corrosive gas atmosphere
L274@P14: 3.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L275@P14: 3.2 Long-term storage
L276@P14: 3.2.1 Cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term
L277@P14: storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L278@P14: 3.2.2 If long-term (but not longer than Warranty Period as set forth in Section 10
L279@P14: (Warranty)) storage is necessary, Cell shall be stored at shipping voltage, because
L280@P14: storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of performance characteristics.
L281@P14: 3.3 Storage period
L282@P14: Samsung SDI shall not be liable for any defects of Cell after Warranty Period even if
L283@P14: Cell is stored in accordance with Sections 3.1 and 3.2 above.
L284@P14: 4. Cycle life
L285@P14: 4.1 Cycle life performance
L286@P14: 4.1.1 Cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in the produce
L287@P14: specification with a certain level of capacity also specified in the product
L288@P14: specification.
L289@P14: 4.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L290@P14: temperature and/or storage.
L291@P14: 5. Battery Pack Assembly
L292@P14: 5.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged Cell
L293@P14: 5.1.1 Cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L294@P14: 5.1.2 Cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or electrolyte-smell
L295@P14: is detected.
L296@P14: 5.2 Terminals handling
L297@P14: 5.2.1 Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip
L298@P14: terminal is welled.
L299@P14: 5.3 Transportation
L300@P14-15: 5.3.1 If Cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer, careful SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L301@P15: Spec. No. CC5563F101 Version No. Draft 1.0
L302@P15: Samsung SDI., Battery Business Division.15
L303@P15: precautions should be taken to avoid damage of Cell.
L304@P15: 6. Others
L305@P15: 6.1 Disassembly
L306@P15: 6.1.1 Cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L307@P15: 6.1.2 Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or
L308@P15: venting.
L309@P15: 6.1.3 When the electrolyte is coming in contact with the skin or eyes, wash
L310@P15: immediately with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L311@P15: 6.2 Short-circuiting
L312@P15: 6.2.1 Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L313@P15: 6.2.2 An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L314@P15: 6.3 Incineration
L315@P15: 6.3.1 Incinerating and disposing of Cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may
L316@P15: cause rupture and explosion.
L317@P15: 6.4 Immersion
L318@P15: 6.4.1 Soaking Cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and
L319@P15: leakage of components to be damaged to functions.
L320@P15: 6.5 Mixing use
L321@P15: 6.5.1 Different types of Cell, or same types but different Cell manufacturer's shall not
L322@P15: be used, which may lead to Cell imbalance, Cell rupture or damage to system due
L323@P15: to the different characteristics of Cell.
L324@P15: 6.5.2 Do not mix use Cells from different batches/ranks even they are the same Cell
L325@P15: types from the same manufacturer.
L326@P15: 6.6 Battery disposal
L327@P15: 6.6.1 Although Cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as lead or
L328@P15: cadmium. the battery should be disposed according to the local regulations when
L329@P15: it is disposed.
L330@P15: 6.6.2 Cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by an
L331@P15: inadvertent short-circuit.
L332@P15: 6.7 Caution
L333@P15: 6.7.1 The Battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if
L334@P15: mistreated.
L335@P15: 6.7.2 Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100℃ or incinerate it.
L336@P15: 6.7.3 Replace battery with Samsung SDI battery only.
L337@P15: 6.7.4 Use of another battery may present a risk of fire or explosion.
L338@P15: 6.7.5 Dispose of used battery promptly.
L339@P15: 6.7.6 Keep away from children.
L340@P15-16: 6.7.7 Do not disassemble and do not dispose of in fire.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L341@P16: Spec. No. CC5563F101 Version No. Draft 1.0
L342@P16: Samsung SDI., Battery Business Division.16
L343@P16: Pack Design Guideline for Lithium Ion Cells
L344@P16: If a customer’s battery pack cannot meet Pack Design Guideline below, SDI shall
L345@P16: not be responsible for any quality issues arising out of or in connection with Cell.
L346@P16: 1. Electrical design
L347@P16: 1.1 Charge
L348@P16: 1.1.1 Stop charging the battery if charging isn't completed within the specified time.
L349@P16: 1.1.2 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L350@P16: Don't exceed these ranges.
L351@P16: Charge temperature ranges : 0℃ ~ 45℃
L352@P16: 1.1.3 Charge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L353@P16: 1.1.4 Cut-off Voltage of charging must be 4.2V.
L354@P16: 1.1.5 Charger must stop charging battery by detecting either charging time or current
L355@P16: specified in Cell specification.
L356@P16: 1.1.6 Recharge Voltage must be at least 0.1V lower than Max charging Voltage.
L357@P16: 1.1.7 Do not charge the battery under 1.0V voltage.
L358@P16: 1.1.8 Voltage range of the battery for pre-charge mode is 1.0 ~ 3.0V with a charging
L359@P16: current of 0.1 ~ 0.5C.
L360@P16: 1.2 Discharge
L361@P16: 1.2.1 Discharge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L362@P16: 1.2.2 Cut-off Voltage of discharging must be over 2.5V.
L363@P16: 1.2.3 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L364@P16: Don't exceed these ranges.
L365@P16: Discharge temperature ranges : -10℃ ~ 60℃
L366@P16: 1.3 Storage
L367@P16: Store the battery at low temperature (below 60℃, 20℃ is recommended), low humidity
L368@P16: (below 65%), no dust and no corrosive gas atmosphere.
L369@P16: 1.4 Design of positioning the battery pack in application and charger
L370@P16: To prevent the deterioration of the battery performance caused by heat, battery shall be
L371@P16: positioned away from the area where heat is generated in the application and the
L372@P16: charger.
L373@P16: 1.5 Safety Device
L374@P16: Be sure adopting proper safe device such as PTC specified type or model in Cell
L375@P16: Specification. If you intend to adopt different safety device which is not specified in Cell
L376@P16: Specification, please contact Samsung SDI to investigate any potential safety problem.
L377@P16: Be sure designing 2nd protective devices such as PTC & PCM at the same time to protect
L378@P16: Cell just in case one protective device is fault.
L379@P16: 2. Design of System
L380@P16: 2.1 Connection between Cells and the battery
L381@P16: 2.1.1 Cell should not be soldered directly with other Cells. Namely, Cell should be welded
L382@P16: with leads on its terminal and then be soldered with wire or leads to solder.
L383@P16-17: 2.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause damage of component, such as separator and insulator, SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L384@P17: Spec. No. CC5563F101 Version No. Draft 1.0
L385@P17: Samsung SDI., Battery Business Division.17
L386@P17: by heat generation.
L387@P17: 2.2 Positioning the battery in the System
L388@P17: 2.2.1 The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources and high
L389@P17: temperature components.
L390@P17: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L391@P17: 2.2.3 The recommended space between Cells is more than 1mm.
L392@P17: 2.3 Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L393@P17: 2.3.1 The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack in
L394@P17: order to minimize shock, which can damage Cells. .
L395@P17: 2.3.2 Otherwise, it may cause shape distortion, leakage, heat generation and/or rupture
L396@P17: and/or open circuit.
L397@P17: 2.3.3 Ultrasonic should not be used when manufacturing battery packs as it can damage
L398@P17: the connection between component parts.
L399@P17: 2.4 Short-circuit protection of Cell
L400@P17: 2.4.1 Cell is equipped with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which may occur
L401@P17: during transportation, battery assembly and /or system operation.
L402@P17: 2.4.2 If Cell sleeve is damaged by some causes such as outside impact, it may cause
L403@P17: short-circuit with some wiring inside the battery.
L404@P17: 2.5 Connection between the battery and charger/system
L405@P17: 2.5.1 The battery should be designed to be connected only to the specified charger and
L406@P17: system.
L407@P17: 2.5.2 A reverse connection of the battery, even in the specified system, should be
L408@P17: avoided by employing special battery design such as a special terminals.
L409@P17: 2.6 Pack design
L410@P17: 2.6.1 The current consumption of the battery pack should be under 10uA at sleep mode.
L411@P17: 2.6.2 Cell voltage monitoring system.
L412@P17: The system (charger or pack) should be equipped with a device to monitor each
L413@P17: voltage of Cell block to avoid Cell imbalance which can cause damage to Cells.
L414@P17: 2.6.3 The battery pack or system should have warning system such as over
L415@P17: temperature, over voltage, over current, and so on.
